items.title: La última gran noche de Roger Federer en Nueva York
items.description: El suizo se dio un baño de masas y dejó perlas de lo que todavía es capaz: reveses ganadores, un recital al servicio y magia por doquier en la Arthur Ashe.

items.title: Medvedev vuelve a perder y desciende a la locura: "Debería empezar a jugar al pickleball"
items.description: Nueva derrota para Daniil: llegará al US Open con solo un triunfo en la gira norteamericana... desencadenando un nuevo discurso surrealista en pleno partido.

items.title: Alcaraz transmite optimismo tras el dobles mixto: "Me siento increíble a pesar de haber perdido"
items.description: Serena Williams, su compañera en una ocasión histórica, compartió un vídeo en redes sociales de los momentos postderrota... y mostró a un Carlos feliz y con una sonrisa de oreja a oreja. ¿Hay confianza?

items.title: Alcaraz and Williams thrill in brief but bright US Open mixed doubles showing
items.description: Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz were among the star double-acts in New York as the US Open mixed doubles competition got under way on Tuesday.

items.title: GB's Dart and Jones advance in US Open qualifying
items.description: Britons Harriet Dart and Fran Jones both make winning starts in their bids to reach the US Open singles main draw.

items.title: Retiring Wawrinka 'forever grateful' to US Open despite no wildcard
items.description: Stan Wawrinka says his US Open triumph will "forever be one of the greatest moments of my life" after missing out on a wildcard for a farewell appearance in New York.

items.title: Vondrousova appeals to Cas against four-year ban
items.description: Former Wimbledon champion Marketa Vondrousova did not let an anti-doping official enter her home to carry out a test in December 2025 and her ban is set to run until June 2030.

items.title: Watson among Britons through in US Open qualifying
items.description: Heather Watson is among the British winners in the first round of US Open qualifying as she bids for a first New York main-drawn appearance in five years.

items.title: Gauff gears up for US Open with Cincinnati triumph
items.description: Coco Gauff powers past Jessica Pegula in the final of the Cincinnati Open to win her first title of 2026 just before the US Open, as Arthur Fils wins the men's event.

items.title: Injured Sinner & Draper withdraw from US Open
items.description: World number one Jannik Sinner and Britain's Jack Draper pull out of the upcoming US Open through injury.

items.title: Rybakina retires injured in quarter-final against Swiatek
items.description: Elena Rybakina's latest bid to replace Aryna Sabalenka as world number one comes to an abrupt end as she retires injured against Iga Swiatek in Cincinnati.

items.title: US Open offers biggest prize fund in Grand Slam history
items.description: The US Open will offer the biggest prize fund in Grand Slam history with a total of $108 million (£79.2m) on offer - marking a 20% increase on last year.

items.title: Alcaraz to play US Open after four months out
items.description: Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz is set to make his return at the US Open after missing four months with a wrist injury.

items.title: One month or four years? Timing key in Kyrgios ban

items.title: Sabalenka stunned by Bejlek as slump continues
items.description: Aryna Sabalenka's preparations for her US Open title defence suffer a setback in a surprise defeat by Sara Bejlek at the Cincinnati Open.

items.title: Why positive cocaine test could mean end of Kyrgios' career
items.description: Nick Kyrgios once said he did not want to play tennis into his 30s. A positive cocaine test could have brought an end to his career aged 31.

items.description: Venus Williams is given a wildcard for the US Open singles - and sister Serena could potentially still join her with one spot remaining.

items.title: Williams sisters 'find our way to each other' but lose on doubles return

items.title: Fery named in GB Davis Cup team to face Ecuador

items.title: Fery wins on return as Djokovic reveals health condition after loss
items.description: Britain's Arthur Fery beats Australia's James Duckworth at the Cincinnati Open but Novak Djokovic falls to a shock defeat by Argentina's Thiago Tirante.

items.title: Swiatek beats Rybakina for first title of season
items.description: Iga Swiatek secures her first WTA title of the season with a straight-set victory over Elena Rybakina in the final of the Canadian Open.

items.title: Swiatek into first final of her 'toughest season'
items.description: Iga Swiatek will meet Elena Rybakina in the Canadian Open final after both players battled through their semi-finals in three sets.

items.title: Tearful Draper struggles during comeback defeat

items.title: Boulter to lead GB at Billie Jean King Cup finals
